import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem power_period_shift_mod_seven (n m : ℕ) : (5 : ℤ) ^ (30 * n + m) ≡ (5 : ℤ) ^ m [ZMOD 7] := by
  have h₁ : (5 : ℤ) ^ (30 * n + m) ≡ (5 : ℤ) ^ m [ZMOD 7] := by
    
    rw [show (5 : ℤ) ^ (30 * n + m) = (5 : ℤ) ^ (30 * n) * (5 : ℤ) ^ m by
      {
        rw [pow_add]
        <;> ring
      }]
    
    have h₂ : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
      norm_num [Int.ModEq, Int.emod_eq_of_lt]
    have h₃ : (5 : ℤ) ^ (30 * n) ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
      
      calc
        (5 : ℤ) ^ (30 * n) = ((5 : ℤ) ^ 30) ^ n := by
          rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm]
        _ ≡ 1 ^ n [ZMOD 7] := by
          
          gcongr
          <;> simp_all [Int.ModEq]
        _ = 1 := by simp
        _ ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by simp [Int.ModEq]
    
    calc
      (5 : ℤ) ^ (30 * n) * (5 : ℤ) ^ m ≡ 1 * (5 : ℤ) ^ m [ZMOD 7] := by
        
        gcongr
        <;> simp_all [Int.ModEq]
      _ = (5 : ℤ) ^ m := by simp
      _ ≡ (5 : ℤ) ^ m [ZMOD 7] := by simp [Int.ModEq]
  exact h₁

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem power_period_shift_mod_seven (n m : ℕ) : (5 : ℤ) ^ (30 * n + m) ≡ (5 : ℤ) ^ m [ZMOD 7] := by
  have h : (5 : ℤ) ^ 30 ≡ 1 [ZMOD 7] := by
    norm_num [Int.ModEq]
  have hn := h.pow n
  calc
    (5 : ℤ) ^ (30 * n + m) =
        (5 : ℤ) ^ (30 * n) * (5 : ℤ) ^ m := by
          rw [pow_add]
    _ = ((5 : ℤ) ^ 30) ^ n * (5 : ℤ) ^ m := by
          rw [pow_mul]
    _ ≡ (1 : ℤ) ^ n * (5 : ℤ) ^ m [ZMOD 7] := by
          exact hn.mul_right _
    _ = (5 : ℤ) ^ m := by
          norm_num
